derivation: The dispatch exactly matches the permit, so the lifecycle classification is MATCHED with no mismatch of its own: completion_mismatch is false and the embedded native record copies the reservation's exact retained request. RES-WIRE-003 requires all prescribed committed event records in every supplied current journal before a settlement can be claimed. The supplied history is the registry's original opening journal, which never recorded this effect's prescribed event, so journal corroboration fails independently of the clean dispatch. The registry retains disputed exposure with reason HISTORY_UNCORROBORATED rather than settling. LIFE-010's disposition table places this budget-disputed MATCHED classification under the general budget-disputed row, so the lifecycle changes the occurrence to BLOCKED_DISPUTE and does not apply the otherwise matching success route.
